title: Multioutput prediction protected reference solution and review guide
answer: A strong submission for Multioutput prediction should complete this objective: Train a model for multiple targets. It should demonstrate the expected outcome (Handle multiple prediction outputs.), use a consistent and reproducible setup, report evidence rather than speculation, and address the limitation: Report target dimensions and explain how per-target errors are summarized.
explanation: Review the result for technical correctness and reproducibility. The automatic check only looks for MultiOutputRegressor, y.shape, mean_absolute_error and does not run the learner code. Report target dimensions and explain how per-target errors are summarized.
